_metadata.description: Iterative editing over existing audio: separation, cover, repaint, accompaniment.

requirements.title: Stem separation independent of the generator
requirements.description: Stem separation is served by a dedicated separator that does not require the composition model to be resident, because the generation variant that fits constrained VRAM may not expose separation at all.

validation.notes: Separation succeeds with no composition model loaded

requirements.title: Section repaint and cover preserve identity
requirements.description: Repaint regenerates a bounded time range while leaving the remainder byte-identical, and cover restyles a track while preserving its structure — so a near-miss can be edited rather than rerolled.

validation.notes: Repaint leaves out-of-range audio unchanged; cover preserves segment structure
